evidence.continuity: Film Anpu (005-018) checkered collar and gold wrap vs 3D Anpu (040-042) plain torso, olive kilt side panel, thin sceptre; sceptre height varies by shot. Ankhu brown sandals present in 005, 008, 009, 012, 018, 040, 041, 042, 048. Bronze props canon-correct.
evidence.cinematography: Hard cuts mostly read, 048 strong closing composition; but 023 oversized Ankhu with Anpu cropped, 025-028 and 037-039 small figures in wide/overhead, 030-034 and 040-046 attendants block leads, 014 crops Anpu's head and sceptre.
evidence.motion_fx: Stiff frozen mid-stride poses (040, 041, 042); group stacked in a clump 043-046; no foot dust visible in any walk frame; brazier flames the only visible FX.
evidence.grounding: 042 attendant on top of brazier pedestal with flame missing; 039 attendant clips into jackal statue; 020 attendant heads cut off at bottom edge; 043-046 leads overlap into one blob at the gate; shadows soft and not matching painted light direction.
evidence.game_feel: Clear where to go (lit gate at the end of the causeway), but camera handover to tiny or occluded characters (037-046) hides the avatar, and 043-046 feels like a stall before the 047 fade.
evidence.ui_title: Title logo and hierarchy clear; menu (000-004) small and low-contrast bottom-left; subtitles 035-042 legible serif bottom-centre, but 035 faded with no 'Will I see them?' line.
evidence.audio: From scripts only, no timing file: Anpu 5 lines (cam2.b-cam6.a) and Ankhu 4 (cam2.a-cam5.a) alternate well, warm grave arc confession -> recognition -> road's price -> walk invitation; pacing and delivery unverified.

defects.what: 3D Anpu, Ankhu and attendants do not match the painted film designs: Anpu lacks checkered collar and gold wrap, has olive kilt panel and thin sceptre; generic muscular figures sit flat and unlit against the painted set.
Attendants walk in front of and occlude Anpu and Ankhu; wide and overhead cuts shrink characters to tiny figures; ending stack at the gate is an unreadable clump.
Attendant stands on the brazier pedestal, another clips into the jackal statue head, heads cropped at frame edge; stiff frozen strides with no foot dust or contact FX.
